mapper.select: select focus_user_id userId, count(1) statisticsCount from user_focus where DATE_FORMAT(focus_time, '%Y%m%d') = #{statisticsDate} group by focus_user_id
select max(video_user_id) userId, count(1) statisticsCount from video_comment where DATE_FORMAT(post_time, '%Y%m%d') = #{statisticsDate} group by video_user_id

select video_user_id userId, action_type dataType, sum(action_type) statisticsCount from user_action where DATE_FORMAT(action_time, '%Y%m%d') = #{statisticsDate} and action_type in (#{item}) group by video_user_id, action_type

select ifnull(sum(play_count), 0) playCount, ifnull(sum(like_count), 0) likeCount, ifnull(sum(danmu_count), 0) danmuCount, ifnull(sum(comment_count), 0) commentCount, ifnull(sum(coin_count), 0) coinCount, ifnull(sum(collect_count), 0) collectCount from video_info
and user_id = #{userId}
select count(1) statistics_count, DATE_FORMAT(join_time,'%Y%m%d') statistics_date from user_info group by statistics_date order by statistics_date asc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO statistics_info (statistics_date, user_id, data_type, statistics_count) VALUES (#{statisticsDate}, #{userId}, #{dataType}, #{statisticsCount})
